# Fallback

Tiny paid recovery and decision utilities for autonomous agents.

Pay-per-call tools that help AI agents find sources, diagnose failures, repair requests, and decide when to stop searching.

Catalog: https://fallback.factrail.online/catalog.json
MCP endpoint: https://fallback.factrail.online/mcp (active Streamable HTTP)
Agent skill: https://fallback.factrail.online/skill.md
HTTP execution: active
x402 payments: production mode (eip155:8453, Base mainnet, USDC)
Source (MIT): https://github.com/baronsigma/fallback-agent-tools

## When to use
- Use source_route when you know what information you need but not where to retrieve it in machine-readable form; do not use it for general research or fact verification.
- Use error_route after an API, HTTP, MCP, or tool request fails when the safe next action is unclear; do not use it when recovery is obvious or requires deeper domain reasoning.
- Read error_route evidence and limitations. It classifies supplied information only; it does not execute requests or claim undocumented fixes.

## Tools

### source_route
Find likely authoritative or machine-readable sources when you know what information you need but not where to retrieve it. Provide a goal and optional publisher domain or start URL; it returns ranked candidate routes and bounded evidence. Use it before blind searching. Do not use it when you already have the correct source or only need reasoning over supplied context.
Status: available
Price: $0.02 USD per call (x402 active)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/source_route
MCP: source_route
Category: source-discovery
Latency target: 12000 ms
Input schema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"goal":{"type":"string","minLength":3,"maxLength":500,"description":"What information to retrieve, in 3 to 500 characters. IP addresses, URLs, and credentials are rejected.","type":"string","maxLength":253,"format":"hostname","pattern":"^(?=.{1,253}\\.?$)[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[-0-9a-zA-Z]{0,61}[0-9a-zA-Z])?)*\\.?$"},"start_url":{"description":"Optional absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL to start from. Its path and query are kept. When domain is also set, both must identify the same publisher root.","type":"string","maxLength":2048},"preferred_formats":{"description":"Optional formats to prefer when ranking routes, at most 7. Each item is json, csv, xml, rss, api, bulk_download, or html.","maxItems":7,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["json","csv","xml","rss","api","bulk_download","html"],"description":"One preferred route format: json, csv, xml, rss, api, bulk_download, or html."}},"require_official":{"default":false,"description":"When true, omit search results that are not on the supplied publisher host. Defaults to 5.","type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":10}},"required":["goal"],"additionalProperties":false,"description":"Publisher and goal for bounded source-route discovery. The tool may read public HTTP resources; it does not accept credentials or executable content."}

Example: {"goal":"Download the latest population dataset","domain":"statistics.example"}

### error_route
Diagnose a failed API, HTTP, MCP, or tool request and return a bounded safe next action. Use it after a request fails when the safe next step is unclear. Provide a status, response, or error text; it does not execute requests or verify undocumented fixes.
Status: available
Price: $0.002 USD per call (x402 active)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/error_route
MCP: error_route
Category: recovery
Latency target: 50 ms
Input schema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"goal":{"description":"What the failed call was trying to accomplish, from 1 to 500 characters.","type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"request":{"description":"The failed request. This tool does not send it.","type":"object","properties":{"method":{"description":"HTTP method of the failed request, up to 16 characters.","type":"string","maxLength":16},"url":{"description":"URL of the failed request, up to 2048 characters. This tool does not call it.","type":"string","maxLength":2048},"headers":{"description":"Request headers supplied as diagnostic context. Credential-like values are not required and are redacted from results.","type":"object","propertyNames":{"type":"string","maxLength":128},"additionalProperties":{"type":"string","maxLength":2048}},"body":{"description":"JSON-compatible request body. Serialized size is limited to 8192 characters. It is not forwarded or executed."}},"additionalProperties":false},"response":{"description":"The failed response. Output schema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"classification":{"type":"string","enum":["authentication_required","authorization_denied","rate_limited","quota_exhausted","payment_required","payment_failed","schema_mismatch","invalid_input","not_found","method_not_allowed","unsupported_media_type","timeout","connection_failure","dns_failure","tls_failure","upstream_failure","service_unavailable","conflict","stale_state","malformed_response","blocked_or_challenged","unknown"]},"retry":{"type":"string","enum":["never","immediate","after_delay","after_change","after_auth","after_payment","unknown"]},"safe_to_retry":{"type":"boolean"},"next_action":{"type":"object","properties":{"type":{"type":"string","enum":["modify_request","inspect_schema","wait","authenticate","change_endpoint","reduce_rate","pay","stop_retrying","escalate","unknown"]},"instruction":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":240},"changes":{"maxItems":4,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","maxLength":160}}},"required":["type","instruction","changes"],"additionalProperties":false},"confidence":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1},"evidence":{"maxItems":8,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"signal":{"type":"string","maxLength":40},"value":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","maxLength":160},{"type":"number"},{"type":"boolean"}]}},"required":["signal","value"],"additionalProperties":false}},"limits":{"maxItems":6,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","maxLength":180}},"tool_version":{"type":"string"}},"required":["classification","retry","safe_to_retry","next_action","confidence","evidence","limits","tool_version"],"additionalProperties":false}
Example: {"goal":"Retrieve a company profile","request":{"method":"POST","url":"https://api.example/company"},"response":{"status":400,"body":"current_company_domain is not a valid field"}}

### request_repair
Repair a failed API or HTTP request using only supplied schema and error evidence. Use after error_route identifies a request-shape or input problem. Returns the smallest justified request changes and abstains when evidence is insufficient.
Status: available
Price: $0.005 USD per call (x402 active)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/request_repair
MCP: request_repair
Category: recovery
Latency target: 50 ms

### stop_search
Decide whether another search or paid retrieval is worth the cost based on the scope already checked. Use after several search or source checks when you need to decide whether to continue or return a scoped not-found result. It does not prove universal absence and performs no searches itself.
Status: available
Price: $0.003 USD per call (x402 active)
HTTP: https://fallback.factrail.online/v1/tools/stop_search
MCP: stop_search
Category: search-quality
Latency target: 25 ms
Input schema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"goal":{"description":"What the caller is still trying to find, from 1 to 500 characters.","type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"checks":{"default":[],"description":"Checks the caller already performed, at most 40. ## Related
- FACTRAIL MCP: https://factrail.online/llms.txt. Separate service for source-backed facts with support levels, unresolved fields, and receipts.
